_comment: ADOPTER EXAMPLE (2.1.0 · hardening plan 4.2) — the data-protection impact assessment for one change, mounted beside its envelope under docs/governance/changes/<id>/dpia.json. Required at PA1 whenever the compiled plan carries the `dpia` capability (the base profile compiles it on flags.personal_data). Every category resolves in docs/governance/data-lifecycle.json; residency is a stated fact the gate reads, not a paragraph; risks each carry a mitigation; the signature is a data-protection HUMAN outside the builders group. What the gate proves: that the assessment exists, is complete, and was signed by the right function. Whether the mitigations are adequate is the data-protection function's judgement, not a property of this file.
purpose: affordability assessment in the credit-limit decision path
lawful_basis: contract performance and the CBUAE affordability obligation
necessity: income, obligations and bureau score are the minimum inputs an affordability determination can be made on; no marketing or profiling use
residency: UAE-resident stores only; the model runs onshore; no cross-border transfer of personal data

risks.risk: bureau and income data reaching a log sink in cleartext
risks.mitigation: pii-guard hook on the delivery loop; structured logging with field-level redaction; DR-1 in the data-risk register

risks.risk: an affordability decision the customer cannot understand or contest
risks.mitigation: decision reasons emitted per decision; contest route via the complaints channel (decision-contestability.json)
data-lifecycle dispositions: P6Y contact details with crypto-shred; audit log under the AML statutory hold
